name: Kawa to Shoujo to Tokimeki Camping
original_name: 川と少女とときめきキャンプ
source:
You and two girls who you see as your little sisters go on a camping trip.
Frolic in the water with naked Izumi-chan and Fuuka-chan! 

[Modified from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE152941.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你和兩名視作妹妹的女孩去露營。在水中與裸身的泉和風花嬉戲！
